title: readImageData
body:
## readImageData

Reads one VTK XML image data file (.vti) into vtkImageData: a uniform grid defined by extent, origin and spacing, with point and cell arrays. Use it for voxel or pixel data such as sampled volumes, resampled CFD fields or images exported by ParaView; the result suits volume rendering, contouring and image filters. For curvilinear or irregular meshes use readStructuredGrid or readUnstructuredGrid.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Every point and cell array is read; on large volumes use the generated pvXMLImageDataReader binding, which can select arrays.
- Only one file is read; for a time series use a .pvd collection (pvPVDReader) or the generated pvXMLImageDataReader binding.

Native constructor: `XMLImageDataReader`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `files` | The list of files to be read by the reader. Each file is expected to be in the VTK XML image data format. The standard extension is .vti. If more than one file is specified, the reader will switch to file series mode in which it will pretend that it can support time and provide one file per time step. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"minItems":1,"maxItems":1}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "readImageData",
  "options": {
    "files": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
